## LinkBuild — Backlink Exchange Platform
LinkBuild is a white-hat backlink exchange platform for SEO professionals. We help website owners find verified link partners, automate outreach, monitor backlinks 24/7, and boost domain authority with safe, Google-compliant link building methods.

## Quick Info
- **Product**: SaaS Backlink Exchange Platform
- **Pricing**: Free ($0), Pro ($20/mo), Agency ($99/mo), Custom (tailored pricing)
- **Users**: 15,000+ domains registered
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Support**: support@linkbuild.store

## Core Features
- Automated Backlink Exchange with verified partners
- Niche-specific matching (Marketing, SaaS, Education, Finance, Health, Tech, Real Estate, etc.)
- 24/7 Backlink Health Monitoring
- Domain Authority (DA) Tracking
- Spam Score Checking
- E2E Encrypted Messaging between partners
- Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
- Google-compliant White-Hat methodology
- Multi-website management (Free=1, Pro=10, Agency=unlimited)

## How LinkBuild Works
1. **Register & Add Website**: Sign up and add your domain with niche, country, and metrics
2. **Verify Ownership**: Verify domain ownership via DNS TXT record or HTML meta tag
3. **Find Partners**: Browse the marketplace filtered by niche, DA, country, language
4. **Exchange Backlinks**: Send exchange requests, negotiate terms via encrypted chat
5. **Monitor Health**: Track backlink status, detect broken links, maintain link health

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (Vanilla)
- Backend: Convex (real-time serverless backend)
- Database: Convex DB (document-based)
- Authentication: Google OAuth + custom token-based auth
- Hosting: Vercel (static hosting + serverless functions)
- Charts: Chart.js for analytics visualization
- Fonts: Google Fonts (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter)
